# Made-up notes
## What the reply holds

A line with `inline code`, **bold**, *italic*, ***both***, ~~struck~~, and **`code in bold` / `more code`:** after. A long span `Array.isArray(value) || value.length !== 2` wraps with its words (scored 343 lines): the parenthesis stays with them. A call `tuple(a, b, label)` too.

A [link with words](https://example.com/docs) and a bare address https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/keeps/going/with/no/spaces/at/all. Backticks in code: `` a `tick` inside ``.
A hard break here,\
and the next line.

8. Eighth, the list starting late
9. Ninth, a longer line that wraps onto the next line when the drawer is narrow
   - nested bullet with `code`
   - another nested one
10. Tenth: the numbers end on one edge

- [ ] a task not done
- [x] a task done

> A block quote with `code` and **bold**.

| Part | What it says |
|---|---|
| `alpha` | a cell long enough to wrap in its column |
| beta | short |
